prologue_intro.speaker: nell
prologue_intro.text: Dad. The water's under the door. Like, actually in the room.

prologue_intro.speaker: dad
prologue_intro.text: Shoes, coat, phone. Nothing else, Nell. I mean it.

prologue_intro.speaker: nell
prologue_intro.text: The book's on the shelf. The one you made me. I'm not leaving it.

prologue_intro.speaker: nell
prologue_intro.text: Then I'll carry it, and you can carry the argument. Go.

prologue_patch.speaker: patch
prologue_patch.text: Behold! Patch the Magnificent. Hero of page one. Owner of the finest tail in Foldwick, possibly in literature.

prologue_patch.speaker: patch
prologue_patch.text: ...Why is the page wet? Why is the page getting MORE wet?

prologue_patch.speaker: patch
prologue_patch.text: Okay. Okay. Heroes don't run. Heroes stride away very quickly.

midnight_boast.speaker: patch
midnight_boast.text: Watch closely, Drizzle. You are about to see the finest climber on this shelf. Possibly in the whole library.

midnight_boast.speaker: patch
midnight_boast.text: And I was right yesterday. Consistency. That's what greatness is.

midnight_boast.speaker: patch
midnight_boast.text: Try to keep up. And don't rain on anything. These are Gran's books.

midnight_stack.speaker: drizzle
midnight_stack.text: You did it! You're the best climber in the whole book!

midnight_stack.speaker: patch
midnight_stack.text: In the whole book. Somebody should write that down.

midnight_stack.speaker: drizzle
midnight_stack.text: I'll remember it. I remember everything you do.

midnight_stack.speaker: patch
midnight_stack.text: Course you do. Come on. The far end of the shelf is where the good view is.

midnight_dark.speaker: drizzle
midnight_dark.text: Patch? Why did the lamps go out?

midnight_dark.speaker: drizzle
midnight_dark.text: There's no draught in here. There's never a draught in here.

midnight_dark.speaker: patch
midnight_dark.text: Then it's nothing. And heroes don't get scared of nothing.

rising_pinned.speaker: drizzle
rising_pinned.text: Patch! My leg. The spine came down on me, I can't—

rising_pinned.speaker: patch
rising_pinned.text: Hold still. I'll lift it. I'll just... get my shoulder under...

rising_pinned.speaker: narrator
rising_pinned.text: It did not move. Below them, the ink found the bottom shelf and kept coming.

rising_pinned.speaker: drizzle
rising_pinned.text: It's coming up. Patch, it's coming up!

rising_pinned.speaker: patch
rising_pinned.text: I'll get help. Gran. I'll get Gran. I'll be right back.

rising_pinned.speaker: drizzle
rising_pinned.text: Don't go. Please. Patch, don't go.
